create_reward_model: create a reward model from config, observation space, action space, and sequence length parameters
run_RunningMeanStd_update: run an online running mean and variance update on a new batch of tensor data

review_RewardSharedWeights_add_mean_var: review the RewardSharedWeights class method that sets mean and variance attributes for normalization
